title: Test and Lint Workflow
description: Automated testing and linting workflow for the project.
steps: Run npm run lint to check code style and catch potential issues.
Run npm run test to execute unit and integration tests.
Run npm run build to verify the build process.
Run npm run test:watch for watch-mode testing.
Run npm run test:coverage for coverage reports.
notes: Run 'npm run lint' to check code style. Run 'npm run test' to execute unit tests. Use 'npm run test:watch' for watch mode. Use 'npm run test:coverage' for coverage reports. Use 'npm run lint' to enforce code style rules.
